conclusion.vertex_position_decode: first three signed int16 components divided by 32767 for common D1 static primary streams
conclusion.important_distinction: Charm transposes the shipped matrix before System.Numerics.Matrix4x4.Decompose because System.Numerics uses a different matrix/vector convention. That transpose is an API adaptation, not an instruction to transpose again when using a column-vector numpy/trimesh matrix.

source_crosschecks.observation: D1Map::GetDataTable reads each 0x40 transform as four 4-float rows and sets Translation from SRT[0][3], SRT[1][3], SRT[2][3]. Scale is computed from the first three components of rows, then applied to each static instance.
VertexBuffer::readPosition decodes xyz as signed int16 / 32767; the Static primary-stream path calls that decoder for D1 baked statics.

StaticMapData_D1.ParseTransforms constructs System.Numerics.Matrix4x4 from shipped M0..M3 and explicitly transposes it before Matrix4x4.Decompose, consistent with adapting Tiger's stored convention to System.Numerics.

project_change.corrected_behavior: m is passed to trimesh unchanged

remaining_boundary: This establishes the matrix orientation convention. The separate algebraic test of how the static matrix composes with s_entity_model model_scale/model_translation remains useful for the 24 exact cross-representation records and should still be run when Actions resumes.
